description: This file contains a PHP class 'Zone' within the namespace 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Localisation'. It extends a core controller class and provides methods for listing, creating, editing, and deleting geographical zone data for the OpenCart admin dashboard. The class handles HTTP requests, processes filtering, sorting, pagination, and interacts with models to retrieve and modify localisation zone data, as well as rendering views with the relevant data.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: Controller class for managing localisation zones in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing, filtering, sorting, pagination, and form handling for create/edit operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display and handle the list of zones, including filtering and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to retrieve and display the zone list with applied filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the list of zones based on current filters, sorting, and pagination parameters, and returns the rendered view.

methods.name: getTotalZones
methods.description: Returns the total number of zones matching current filters for pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares data for the create/edit zone form, including populating fields and setting the form title.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of new or edited zone data submitted via POST request.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected zones based on submitted zone IDs.
